lines: Commits on track/p-lifecycle-version, not landed: 87b9574 fix(admin-funds): refuse a fund state change sent from a stale version; 393f892 fix(admin-funds): leave an unreadable If-Match on fund changes unchecked (the review follow-up).

WHAT: PATCH /v1/admin/funds/{fundId} honours If-Match. adminRouteKit.optionalIfMatchVersion reads only a single strong "n" or weak W/"n" (regex ^(?:W/)?"(\d{1,15})"$ on the trimmed value). Absent, *, a list, a bare number or anything else returns undefined, meaning no check, exactly as before this lane. It never answers 400.

patchFundState calls requireFundVersion after catalogRepository.lock and the not-found check, inside the idempotent transaction, before ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS and before any write. A mismatch gets 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fields[if-match], already in the contract. A refusal writes no state, audit row or receipt.

COMPAT (rule 11, git show): v0.15.4, v0.16.0-2, v0.17.0-1 (features/admin/shared/queries.ts:140) and v0.18.0 (features/admin/funds/fundQueries.ts:58) all send If-Match: "<fund.version>", read from GET /v1/admin/funds/{id} (mapFund version = funds.version, the compared column).

funds.version moves only on setState and setCurrentVersion (a lifecycle change or a terms publish). The header never had an effect in production, so per review a mangled or unexpected value falls back to the old unchecked behaviour, bounded by ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS.

Released apps show the refusal as a plain line. v0.15.4-v0.17.1 say 'This fund changed while you were editing. It has been reloaded' but do not reload. v0.18.0 says 'Reload the fund and try again' with no button. In both, a retry is refused until the admin refreshes the page or reopens the app (stated in DEPLOY.md). No new error code; the response is unchanged.

IDEMPOTENCY (rule 6): If-Match is not hashed; the hash stays {fundId,status} as in every released backend. Released apps always send the header, so hashing would break replay of receipts stored before the deploy or across a rollback. The check runs after the receipt lookup, so a resent accepted change replays. A refused request stores no receipt.

CONTRACT: transitionAdminFundLifecycle declares an optional if-match header as a plain z.string(), since the server accepts any value and checks only the two tag forms. OpenAPI json and d.ts carry the header (regenerated by the script); generated/operations.ts is unchanged.

FRONTEND (FundStateCard.tsx): the version is captured when the state button is pressed (stored with the status in the confirm state), so a refetch while the dialog is open cannot hide a change. A refusal with STATE_CONFLICT and fields[if-match] shows the warning 'State unchanged' with 'Reload the fund', which calls lifecycle.reset() and refetches.
Other refusals keep their existing line. Held writes are unchanged (FX-4): Check again resends the same key and If-Match.

DEPLOY.md, one paragraph after the terms one: the strong and weak tags are checked, and *, a list or an unreadable value is not. Another admin's terms publish also makes an older page's pause or archive refused. The older apps' refusal wording does not reload. Earlier backends ignore the header. Held changes replay across rollback and roll-forward.

BACKEND TESTS, adminFundLifecycleVersion.integration.test.ts, 9 tests: stale strong refused and nothing changed (row, audit count, receipt); matching applies; no header applies; replay with the same If-Match and replay of an old-hash receipt.

BACKEND TESTS, continued: weak W/"n" stale refused with nothing changed, and a current weak tag applies; *, '"1", "2"' and 'not-a-version' are each applied unchecked; two changes from one version blocked on the lock give exactly one 200 and one 409 if-match, plus one audit row.

FRONTEND TESTS, funds/heldWrites.test.tsx: (a) a stale refusal shows the warning; Reload the fund clears it and shows Paused; exactly one write with ifMatch '"7"'. (b) Archive is pressed at version 7, the fund is refetched at version 8 while the dialog is open (the card shows 8), and the confirm still sends ifMatch '"7"'.

Commit: 87b9574 fix(admin-funds): refuse a fund state change sent from a stale version (one commit on track/p-lifecycle-version, not landed).

WHAT: PATCH /v1/admin/funds/{fundId} now honours If-Match. adminRouteKit.parseIfMatchVersion (never called by any release) became optionalIfMatchVersion: absent or empty means no check; a malformed value gets 400 VALIDATION_FAILED fields[if-match]; otherwise a number.

patchFundState calls requireFundVersion after catalogRepository.lock and the not-found check, inside the idempotent transaction, before ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS and before any write. On a mismatch it refuses 409 STATE_CONFLICT with fields[if-match] (the code requirePublishedFrom uses; already in the contract). A refusal writes no state, audit row or receipt.

COMPAT (rule 11, git show): v0.15.4, v0.16.0-2, v0.17.0-1 (features/admin/shared/queries.ts:140) and v0.18.0 (features/admin/funds/fundQueries.ts:58) all send If-Match: "<fund.version>". The value comes from GET /v1/admin/funds/{id}, where mapFund version = funds.version, the exact column compared. So the header is honoured as sent.

funds.version moves only in setState and setCurrentVersion (a lifecycle change or a terms publish), so a mismatch always means the fund changed after the app read it. Released apps never send a malformed value.

Refusal display in released apps: v0.15.4-v0.17.1 show STATE_CONFLICT as the plain line 'This fund changed while you were editing. It has been reloaded - review and try again.' v0.18.0 FundStateCard shows 'State unchanged: This fund changed after the page loaded, so its state was not changed. Reload the fund and try again.' No new error code; the response shape is unchanged.

Behaviour change for released apps: a click sent from a stale page (another admin's change, or a click before the post-success refetch lands) is now refused plainly instead of applied. Before, it was bounded only by ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS. A request with no header behaves as before.

IDEMPOTENCY (rule 6): If-Match is NOT in the request hash, which stays {fundId,status} as in every released backend. Released apps always send the header, so 'hash only when sent' (the p-terms-version choice) would have changed every lifecycle hash. Held Check again across the deploy, a rollback or a roll-forward would then answer IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED instead of replaying.

The check runs inside execute, after the receipt lookup: a resent accepted change replays its stored 200 and is not refused as stale. A refused request stores no receipt, so a resend with the same key is evaluated again. Trade-off: the same key sent with a different If-Match replays the first outcome; apps resend identical headers.

CONTRACT: transitionAdminFundLifecycle declares an optional if-match header (FundLifecycleHeaders = OptionalAdminMutationHeaders.shape + if-match matching ^"?\d{1,15}"?$). OpenAPI json and d.ts were regenerated by the script. Frontend generated/operations.ts is unchanged (it only re-exports operations).

FRONTEND (FundStateCard.tsx): the version is captured when the state button is pressed, not at confirm, so a refetch while the dialog is open cannot hide a change. A refusal with STATE_CONFLICT and fields[if-match] shows the warning 'State unchanged' with a 'Reload the fund' button, which resets the write and refetches the fund.
Other refusals keep the existing error line. Held writes are unchanged (FX-4): Check again resends the same key and If-Match; the existing ROWS case asserts identical options.

DEPLOY.md: one paragraph after the terms paragraph. Earlier backends ignore the header, so after an images-only rollback a stale change is bounded only by the transitions again. The header is not hashed, so held changes replay across either move.

TESTS: new backend/test/integration/adminFundLifecycleVersion.integration.test.ts, 5 tests: (1) a stale If-Match is refused 409 with fields[if-match]; the fund row (state, version, timestamps), the lifecycle audit count and the receipt count stay unchanged. (2) A matching If-Match applies, version+1, one audit row.

(3) No header applies. (4) A resent accepted change replays with the same If-Match, and a receipt made without the header (as the old hash) replays when resent with it. (5) Two changes (pause and archive) from one version, blocked on the fund lock, give exactly one 200 and one 409 with if-match, plus one audit row; the state is the winner's.

The frontend case in funds/heldWrites.test.tsx: Archive is refused as stale, the warning line shows, and Reload the fund shows Paused with the alert gone. Exactly one write was sent, with ifMatch '"7"'.

RED controls (each restored, cmp identical): R1 removing the requireFundVersion call: 20261117T162833Z-117174, 2 failed (tests 1 and 5; the stale archive applied, and the concurrency case gave 200,200).

R2 a guard that always refuses: 20261117T162846Z-121110, 5 failed (tests 2, 3 and 4 detect over-refusal). R3 If-Match added to the hash when sent: 20261117T162903Z-125502, 1 failed (test 4: the old-hash receipt got 409). R4 FundStateCard reverted to HEAD~1: 20261117T162918Z-131047, 1 failed (frontend case).
